Title: Some users with an active Microsoft Teams license may be unable to sign in to Microsoft Teams

User impact: Users with an active Microsoft Teams license may be unable to sign in to Microsoft Teams.

More info: Additionally, admins may be unable to access organization-wide settings.

Current status: We’ve received reports that some users with an active Microsoft Teams license are unable to sign in to Microsoft Teams. Our assessment has determined that a recent authorization configuration change intended to block users without active licenses is resulting in impact. We’re validating a remediation action to revert the offending change and will provide a resolution timeline once available.

Scope of impact: Impact may occur for some users with an active Microsoft Teams license who are attempting to sign in to Microsoft Teams. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Root cause: A recent authorization configuration change intended to block users without active licenses inadvertently blocked some users with active Microsoft Teams licenses, resulting in impact.

Next update by: Thursday, August 27, 2026, at 10:30 PM UTC
